xBRIEFInfo.description: Project definition for the fictional Northstar lifecycle lab

narratives.Overview: A fictional, disposable, no-remote repository for observing Directive scope lifecycle transitions.
narratives.Product: A local greeting example used only to make authorization state visible.
narratives.SourceOfTruth: Lifecycle state lives in xbrief/; the parent evidence directory records lab observations.
narratives.DevelopmentPosture: Private pre-release training fixture with no compatibility layer.
narratives.ProjectRules: Use fictional data only. Keep every mutation inside the unique operating-system temporary repository. Do not add a remote, push, open a pull request, merge, deploy, publish, or release.
